notes.text: CCNL H058 — Assoturismo-Confesercenti. Conglobated. 10 levels: 7-6-6S-5-4-3-2-1-QB-QA. Divisor 172, 14 months. Seniority 36-month cadence, max 6. 5 tranches: Jul-2024 to Nov-2027.

Models the alberghi/campeggi sub-sector only (CCNL H058, conglobated model). Pubblici esercizi and stabilimenti balneari use a split (paga base + contingenza) model with different values — out_of_scope deliberate: these sub-sectors have meaningfully different pay structures requiring separate files.

limitation.remediation: Model the pubblici esercizi and stabilimenti balneari tables (split paga base + contingenza) with a sub-sector input, or record the limitation.

notes.text: Indennita di funzione for QA (EUR 75/month) and QB (EUR 70/month) conglobated into base_salary. Consistent with turismo-federalberghi.json modeling for the same allowances. The CCNL H058 does not publish them as separate line items in the tabella retributiva; absorption into base_salary matches the conglobated model.

Apprenticeship model confirmed: CCNL Turismo Confesercenti provides sotto-inquadramento 2 levels below destination (consistent with Testo Unico apprendistato Art. 11, secondary sources). Modeled as 100% passthrough pending contract text; the engine supports under_classification tracks with levels_below. (review of 2026-10-30)

limitation.remediation: Source the contract text and model under_classification tracks (2 levels below destination) instead of the 100% passthrough.

notes.text: TRATTAMENTO INTEGRATIVO SPECIALE (L. 199/2025 art. 1 cc. 18-21): for the work of 1 January - 30 September 2026 of a worker who asked for it (PriorYearTaxFacts.special_supplement_requested) with 2025 employment income up to 40,000 EUR, in an employer of food service, tourism or thermal establishments (EmployerProfile.activity), the engine pays 15% of the gross pay of the night hours and of the holiday overtime (AdE circ. 26/E/2023 par. 2: 'calcolata sulla retribuzione lorda'), outside income, as a credit the employer recovers in F24 (capability special_supplement).

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.section: Art. 117 c.1, c.4 - Festività; Art. 118 c.4 - 4 novembre; Art. 142 - Determinazione della retribuzione giornaliera
location.quote: A tutto il personale assente nelle giornate di festività, per riposo settimanale, per malattia, infortunio, dovrà essere corrisposta 1 giornata di retribuzione contrattuale senza alcuna maggiorazione. [Art. 118] (4) Al lavoratore assente nella stessa giornata per riposo settimanale dovrà essere corrisposta 1 giornata di retribuzione contrattuale senza alcuna maggiorazione. [Art. 142] (1) La retribuzione giornaliera si ottiene dividendo la retribuzione mensile per 26.

provenance.transformation: The national and weekday holidays of art. 117 c.1 (but the S. Patrono della città) and 4 November (art. 118) falling on the worker's weekly rest day (Employment.weekly_rest_day): one day of the monthly pay of the chain over 26 (art. 142). The statutory holidays on a Sunday stay paid by L. 260/1949 art. 5 when the rest day is another day.
provenance.note: Plain Latin-1 text the CNEL archive serves as H058031.rtf. The 2010 renewal (CNEL 1168, OCR) and the 2024 ipotesi of 22 July 2024 (CNEL 194334, OCR) leave arts. 117-118 unchanged; the 2007 and 2018 renewals were not read. 4 October, a holiday from 2026 (L. 151/2025), is not in the list: its rest day stays open. The Patrono is not in the national calendar and is not paid. A rotating rest day is not modelled. The absence for sickness or injury on a holiday (same comma) is left to the sickness treatment.

reviews.scope: Apprentice seniority: art. 58 c. 1 of the accordo of 18 July 2018 (CNEL 90033, p. 116, OCR); the definition of the retribuzione read in the unified CCNL Turismo of 22 July 2003 (art. 140 c. 1 d) and its Federalberghi successor of 20 February 2010 (art. 148 c. 1 d).
findings: The apprentice is paid a percentage of 'la normale retribuzione dei lavoratori qualificati di pari livello' (art. 58); the retribuzione 'è distinta nelle seguenti voci [...] eventuali scatti di anzianità' in the 2003 parent text, a clause the Federalberghi successor keeps; 'A tutto il personale verranno riconosciuti sei scatti' for uninterrupted service: the level increments, scaled by the percentage. The Confesercenti 2010 text itself was not read.
